bullets.text: At Acme Corp, designed payment APIs handling $2B/year using Python and Go.
Led a Kubernetes migration at Acme Corp that cut deploy time by 60%.
Built microservices on AWS at Beta Inc for a logistics platform.

answers.question: Why are you a good fit for this role?
answers.answer: I have seven years of backend experience building high-throughput payment systems in Python and Go, including PostgreSQL-backed APIs at Acme Corp, which maps directly to this role.

answers.question: Describe your most relevant experience for this position.
answers.answer: At Acme Corp I designed payment APIs handling $2B/year and led our Kubernetes migration; earlier at Beta Inc I built AWS microservices.
